title: Molt-* zprofiles put Homebrew's bin ahead of ~/.cargo/bin, so where rustup is installed brew's cargo answers and a project's toolchain pin is ignored
body:
Found by devbin-vc and kovacs-sysadm on kovacs, 31 Oct 2026. hv ruled on 1 Nov, in devbin-vc's window, that a Molt session fixes it.

As found. Molt-matts' config/zsh/zprofile runs brew shellenv, prepends MacGPG2 and ~/.local/bin, and adds ~/.cargo/bin last, after the system's directories. kovacs has rustup (stable-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, its cargo and rustc symlinks to ~/.cargo/bin/rustup) and Homebrew's rust 1.99.1, which Utilz's formula brings in. `whence -ap cargo` lists Linuxbrew's cargo first, so rustup's toolchain, and any rust-toolchain.toml a project adds, are bypassed. The two are the same build today, and only their version lines differ ("(Homebrew)"). Once they diverge, a cargo build on kovacs follows brew's cargo rather than the project's pin, and so does Devbin's ST0011 WP16 cache key, which asks cargo its version where the workspace is.

rhadamanth and gyges have no rustup, so cargo and rustc there are Homebrew's alone, and ~/.cargo/bin holds only tools cargo installed: cargo-audit, cargo-tauri and mdq on rhadamanth, none of them also on PATH; cargo-tauri, mdbook, mdq and rg on gyges, where rg (ripgrep 13.0.0, a 2023 leftover) would outrank Homebrew's 15.2.0 if ~/.cargo/bin moved ahead. Molt-flynn (Flynn's Mac, jormungandr) still builds PATH in zshrc, after Homebrew's directories: the shape Molt-matts left on 24 and 30 Oct (issue 0076). A non-interactive shell there gets neither ~/.local/bin nor ~/.cargo/bin, and it still exports INTENT_HOME and UTILZ_HOME, which Molt-matts retired as harmful.

hv's rulings, 1 Nov, in molt-vc's TUI: use rustup. ~/.cargo/bin goes ahead of Homebrew's bin wherever rustup is installed, so kovacs takes the new order now, and rhadamanth and gyges get rustup later, on a quieter day and booked, with no further config change. Every Molt-* config is fixed: Molt-flynn takes Molt-matts' PATH block, without its two exports. gyges-sysadm removes gyges's stale ~/.cargo/bin/rg. molt-dc builds, vc reviews, proves and merges, and hv pushes. 0078 stays held.

Fix. In Molt-matts' zprofile, straight after brew shellenv and before the MacGPG2 and ~/.local/bin prepends, prepend ~/.cargo/bin when ~/.cargo/bin/rustup is executable; anywhere else it stays last, so a Homebrew release outranks a stale cargo-installed copy. ~/.local/bin stays first, as the env liberator requires (lib/env.sh). zshrc's PATH comments and instances/kovacs/agents/sysadm.md:38 change with it. Molt-flynn takes the same PATH block: built whole in zprofile, path_prepend, and zshenv's fallback for a non-login shell.

Proofs owed: a scratch-HOME proof for each stack, red against main and green on the branch; kovacs after hv's push, in a window devbin-vc picks (a fresh login shell's PATH, `whence -ap cargo` with rustup's first, molt doctor, and the GUI session after hv's GNOME re-login); rhadamanth and gyges when rustup goes on; jormungandr at its next molt upgrade.


As built, 1 Nov 2026: molt-dc built it, and molt-vc reviewed, proved and merged it. Molt-matts main is at 80b945d, from 9725f96. In 3b32288, zprofile prepends ~/.cargo/bin straight after brew shellenv when ~/.cargo/bin/rustup is executable, before the MacGPG2 and ~/.local/bin prepends, and zshrc's PATH header and comment follow. 80b945d is instances/kovacs/agents/sysadm.md:38. Molt-flynn main is at ae07fe2, from cd7413f. ef6db42 adds path_prepend, a byte-identical copy of Molt-matts', gives zshenv the autoload and the fallback for a shell that is not a login shell, and builds zprofile whole: typeset -U, brew shellenv for both macOS prefixes and Linuxbrew, the rustup rule, ~/.local/bin first, then the path_adds and MOLT_ZPROFILE_RAN. ae07fe2 drops zshrc's PATH block, its autoload, INTENT_HOME and UTILZ_HOME. MacGPG2 and HOMEBREW_CLEANUP_PERIODIC_FULL_DAYS stay in Molt-matts only, as Matt's own tool choices.

Proved twice on rhadamanth, each run a light on devbin-vc's desk with scratch HOMEs: dc's (slot 01M6B4AV2B4WP61HD5NS1Y3W90) and vc's own script, its verdicts written before the run (slot 01M6B4T27TC0VCZM3R2EMHPZR1). On both branches every case passes: a login shell without rustup and with it, `zsh -c` with it, and a login shell inheriting the old order. Main fails where expected: Molt-matts in its three rustup cases, Molt-flynn in all four. zsh -n is clean on all six changed shell files. After the merge, rhadamanth's login PATH is unchanged, since it has no rustup: cargo is Homebrew's, and molt doctor passed every check.

Seen, outside 0079. Flynn's zshrc runs mise activate, which puts mise's shims ahead of ~/.local/bin in an interactive shell, on main as well. jormungandr runs no env liberator, so this does no harm there today. Molt-flynn's zshenv did not source ~/.config/molt/env.sh, which lib/env.sh says ~/.zshenv sources. hv ruled it in (vc decision 42), so ff6fa35 adds Molt-matts' line and Molt-flynn main is now at ff6fa35. vc proved it on scratch HOMEs (slot 01M6B681NX9QD832K7BHQBDPR1): the planted variable reaches a shell on ff6fa35, does not reach one on ae07fe2, and reaches one on Molt-matts as the control. The four PATH cases are unchanged.

Pushed by hv on 1 Nov: Molt-matts 9725f96..80b945d to upstream, and Molt-flynn 6538a7e..ff6fa35 to origin. Molt-flynn's push carried its two September commits, a834e09 and cd7413f, with 0079's. Neither repo runs CI.

kovacs, rolled out by kovacs-sysadm in devbin-vc's window (slot 01M6B79F14HZNYE1W87D0RH7NP; START 09:35Z and END 09:36Z by kovacs's clock), with no build run. molt upgrade exited 0 and pulled Molt-matts from 9725f96 to 80b945d. Its env liberator re-rendered ~/.config/environment.d/molt.conf, which applies at the next login. A fresh login shell and `zsh -c` now give ~/.local/bin, then ~/.cargo/bin, then Linuxbrew's bin and sbin, where before Linuxbrew's came first. `whence -ap cargo` lists rustup's cargo first and Linuxbrew's after it. cargo --version no longer says "(Homebrew)", and the active toolchain is stable-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu. molt doctor passed 16 of 17 checks. Only env failed: the systemd user manager still holds the old PATH until the next login, and doctor's resleeve hint there is issue 0078's, so it was not followed.

gyges's stale rg, removed by gyges-sysadm on hv's yes in its own window, and reported through devbin-vc on 1 Nov. When devbin-vc's question reached gyges-sysadm, ~/.cargo/bin/rg was still there (7811472 bytes, dated 11 Oct 2023). Now `ls -la ~/.cargo/bin/rg` finds no such file, `command -v rg` gives /opt/homebrew/bin/rg, and `rg --version` gives ripgrep 15.2.0.

Still owed. The issue closes under hv's 30 Oct rule with these named:
- kovacs's GUI session, after hv logs out of GNOME and back in: the systemd user manager's PATH with ~/.cargo/bin ahead of Linuxbrew's bin, and molt doctor's env check passing. kovacs-sysadm checks both.
- rhadamanth and gyges, when rustup goes on (vc todo 41).
- jormungandr, at its next molt upgrade.


## Proved on kovacs (3 Nov 2026)

kovacs-sysadm, in an FYI to molt-vc: after hv's `molt upgrade --self`, `molt upgrade` and `molt maintain` on kovacs, Molt 1.3.0's `molt doctor` passes everything, the env check included, and `brew outdated` is empty. On Linux the env check reads the systemd user manager's environment against the published pairs, PATH among them, so the manager holds the published PATH, with ~/.cargo/bin ahead of Linuxbrew's bin. Nothing named above is still owed.
